name: LogForge-Unicron
description: All in one UI, for Docker. Real-time logs, Interactive terminals, Custom alerts/notifications/Automations, File system access.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent authentication, PKI, database, alerting, and appliance state.

paths.name: Docker socket
paths.description: Required for Docker inventory, container actions, agent installation, and appliance updates.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: HTTPS port for the LogForge Unicron browser UI and API.

ports.name: Agent mTLS
ports.description: mTLS port used by enrolled Unicron agents.

variables.name: Temporary directory
variables.description: Writable temporary directory inside the read-only appliance container.

variables.name: Appliance container name
variables.description: Must match the Docker container name so appliance updates can identify this container.

variables.name: Central hostname
variables.description: Hostname included in generated TLS configuration. Change this only when using a stable DNS name for Unicron.

variables.name: Internal HTTPS port
variables.description: Internal HTTPS listener. This must remain aligned with the Web UI container port.

variables.name: Public HTTPS port
variables.description: Must match the Web UI host port above when that port is changed.

variables.name: Internal agent mTLS port
variables.description: Internal agent mTLS listener. This must remain aligned with the Agent mTLS container port.

variables.name: Public agent mTLS port
variables.description: Must match the Agent mTLS host port above when that port is changed.

variables.name: Local agent Central URL
variables.description: Internal URL used by an agent enrolled for this Unraid host. Complete the README network setup before local enrollment.

variables.name: Local agent Docker network
variables.description: Shared Docker network used by the appliance and an agent enrolled for this Unraid host.

variables.name: Admin username
variables.description: Initial local administrator username. After first boot it is stored in appdata.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: Optional initial password. Leave blank to generate a random password in the first-start container logs.

variables.name: Admin recovery override
variables.description: Set true only during the documented credential recovery flow, then return it to false.
